task.prompt: Run the reflex loop per the template: Анализ лакун -> Ответ -> Требования -> Коммит (gap analysis -> answer -> requirements -> commit). Analyze the quality-matrix programming quality matrix for VEDO EduTrack requirements artifacts (specs/vision.md, specs/requirements/*, traceability.ttl), identify remaining gaps (lacunas / incomplete cells) after the Iteration 2 NFR commit (14 new NFRs, commit 0fe934d), produce best-practice measurable answers, materialize them as NFR requirement specs in specs/requirements/, and commit the result.
task.ideal_result: Quality matrix shows 0 critical lacunas in columns 2-3, no hierarchy violations in critical rows, all previously partially-covered cells upgraded to measurable coverage, new NFR specs follow REQ-NFR-<area>.<qualifier>.<attribute> conventions with measurable acceptance criteria, traceability.ttl updated, changes committed with conventional commit message
